question: What is the state (or other jurisdiction) of incorporation and the IRS Employer Identification Number?
rationale: Inspected 4 representative cover pages and observed that all 10 10-K filings expose two layout signals: a label phrase ('jurisdiction of incorporation' or 'state of incorporation'; '(I.R.S. Employer Identification No.)') and an EIN value matching the regex \d{2}-\d{7}. A single rule that gathers any span on pages 1-3 whose text/path contains either label phrase or an EIN-pattern number, plus its immediately-preceding span (where the value typically lives), captured all 10 docs with match_rate=1.0 at a sum_avg_cost_ratio of 0.000414. JNJ uses 'State of incorporation' (no 'jurisdiction') and required adding that as a second label alternation; one rule then proved sufficient, so no sibling rules were added.
